name: Tolle
hail: Even, we greet you in the Near season. We prepare for the Far.
Greetings, Even. We are Tolle. We store, we wait, and in season, we speak.
Tolle, to the Even. We have counted the Years, and the time to speak is now.
finding: Counted and counted again, through the seasons: {part}
{part} We will check it again next Year.
{part} Noted, and stored with the rest.
In the Far, there is time to think. {part}
sighting: Seen, and marked against the season: {part}
{part} We have logged it in the Year's count.
Our watch, steady through the seasons, saw this: {part}
{part} Near or Far, we keep watching.
archive: Stored against the Far, and now shared: {part}
{part} Kept in order, Year by Year.
{part} Our records are long, because our winters are.
culture: We are a people of the Near and the Far. {part}
{part} Everything we are follows the Year.
Since the Far Winter, we prepare. {part}
What we are, between one season and the next: {part}
{part} We store, we move, we wait. It is how we live.
request: We ask now, so there is time to prepare: {part}
{part} Answer in your own season. We can wait.
Before the Far comes, we ask: {part}
verdict: {part} We have timed this, as we time everything.
Weighed slowly, as the seasons weigh things: {part}
{part} It stands, through Near and Far.
accord: On the accord, set down in season: {part}
{part} We have counted what it costs across a full Year.
As the seasons turn, so do agreements. {part}
{part} We do nothing out of season, and this is no exception.
